properties.title: Discover the No-Code Magic of Re:Earth WebGIS
properties.description:
Immerse yourself in our workshop featuring Re:Earth, a powerful no-code tool for spatial data visualization. Learn to use its interactive features and create your own plug-ins without coding knowledge.

Join us for an immersive journey into the world of spatial data visualization using Re:Earth, Eukarya Inc.'s revolutionary, no-code, open-source WebGIS tool! With zero coding skills required, Re:Earth opens the door to anyone wanting to view, analyze, and share geographical data in an interactive, engaging way. In our workshop, you'll not only master the basics of Re:Earth but also learn to develop your own unique plug-ins to tailor this versatile platform to your needs. Let's unlock the potential of geospatial data together, and reshape the way we interact with the world around us!
